name: Freeport-McMoRan Inc.
blurb: Freeport-McMoRan is the world's largest publicly traded copper producer, operating the Grasberg mine in Indonesia — one of the largest copper and gold deposits on Earth — alongside mines in North and South America. Copper is a critical input for data-center power infrastructure, server busbars, and the high-bandwidth interconnects inside AI rack systems. Freeport commands roughly 12% of global copper production and is essentially a leveraged bet on global electrification.
recent: Copper demand from AI data-center construction has become a notable demand driver alongside traditional grid and EV cable use, though Freeport's copper-to-AI revenue linkage remains indirect and diffuse. The company reported strong operational results through 2025, though it faces ongoing cost inflation at Grasberg. AI-related copper demand, while real, represents a relatively small share of total copper consumption today.

sources.title: Semiconductors in 2026: The AI-Driven Upswing Meets Structural Bottlenecks — Medium
